appearance.subtle: A scatter of pale freckles across their cheekbones that catch the light oddly.
appearance.obvious: Their skin is mottled with spots that hold a faint green cast, brightest at the throat.
appearance.extreme: They are freckled with cold green light from the jaw down. In an unlit room you could read by them, and they know it.

description: Mottled spots across your skin that hold a faint light of their own. They get brighter near the hot stuff, which is either a warning system or a beacon.
drawbacks: You glow. Faintly, but you glow
name: Radiation Freckles
